mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 65 degrees, which feels more like 59 degrees, and a full moon is in the sky.
City Hall has released the proposed 2027 budget and is currently reviewing development plans for Ardent Glen, Jenna Drive, and Milky Way scheduled for the November 4th meeting.
There is a lot happening in the area starting today with the Dane County Farmers Market, followed by live music at various venues, and trivia nights scheduled throughout the coming week.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle, and since the restaurant is open until 10:30 PM tonight, make sure to head over and grab a treat while you can.
